name: legal-workflows
description: Thirty-two jurisdiction-neutral legal document workflows for review, drafting, comparison, and structured extraction: NDA, MSA, DPA, credit, guarantee, lease, shareholder, employment, BPO, SPA, supply, and e-discovery reviews; redline position analysis; issues lists; CP checklists; key-term extraction; proofreading; and eleven tabular review workflows that extract agreement terms into a Markdown table.

interface.longDescription: A pack of 32 jurisdiction-neutral legal document workflows: structured reviews of NDAs, MSAs, DPAs, credit and guarantee agreements, commercial leases, shareholder and limited-partnership agreements, employment agreements, BPO and design-partner agreements, SPAs, supply agreements, and e-discovery sets; redline-to-position analysis; issues-list and CP-checklist drafting; key-term extraction; proofreading; and 11 tabular workflows that extract agreement terms into a Markdown table using fixed review columns. Bring your own documents by pasting the text into the chat. This is a work-product tool, not legal advice: the plugin does not practise law, does not give jurisdiction-specific legal advice, does not file anything, cannot sign or serve documents, does not track deadlines, does not retain documents, and does not replace qualified counsel. Output is a structured draft to take to a lawyer, and tabular workflows render as Markdown tables rather than spreadsheets. Jurisdiction-specific workflow packs (Finnish, Polish, German, Australian, Singapore, and United States litigation) are not included in this plugin.
capabilities: Review agreements against a defined issue checklist
Draft agreements and closing checklists from a template
Reduce a counterparty redline to its real negotiating positions
Extract key legal and commercial terms from documents
Extract agreement terms into a tabular Markdown review
Compare two document versions clause by clause
defaultPrompt: Review this NDA and list every clause that deviates from a balanced paper.
Paste a counterparty redline below and tell me the positions it actually contains.
Extract the key terms from this credit agreement into a table.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, subscriptions, or services and cannot take a payment. It provides document review, drafting, and analysis workflows free of charge. Any engagement with a qualified lawyer or the publisher is contracted and paid for separately, off-platform.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. 32 jurisdiction-neutral legal workflows: 21 assistant workflows for document review, drafting, comparison, redline analysis, issues lists, checklists, key-term extraction and proofreading, plus 11 tabular review workflows that extract agreement terms into a Markdown table. Upstream workflows are redistributed unmodified under the MIT license from Open-Legal-Products/mike-workflows. Not legal advice and not a substitute for counsel.
